notes.title: Steam Awards 2023
notes.content:
Nominate Warstride Challenges for the "Best Game You Suck At" award 2023! This is the game that rewards persistence, and is not for the faint of heart. It's the toughest game we've ever loved.

[b]Race, aim, fire![/b]

[b]Blast hordes of demons[/b] at lightning speed [b]in bloody gunfights[/b] across a series of increasingly [b]intense trials[/b]. [b]Slow time[/b] to pull off impossible headshots, [b]bunny hop[/b] to pick up speed, slide around corners and [b]shred foes with destructive shockwaves[/b]! [b]Die and retry[/b] to pull off the [b]perfect run[/b], then prove your worth on the [b]global leaderboard[/b] to let the world know you’re the greatest demon slayer.

[b]Race against the clock[/b] to overcome every challenge that comes your way, unlocking and unleashing [b]an arsenal of devastating weapons and powers[/b]. [b]Compete with your friends and the community[/b] to get the highest score and race the ghosts of anyone online – even your favorite streamers! Whether you’re a speedrunner or a shooter beginner, [b]you’ll progress to become an FPS master[/b].

[list]
[*] Get in the flow: [b]blast hordes of demons[/b] in satisfying, bloody combat
[*] Die and retry to get the highest score: [b]show the world you’re the greatest[/b] demon slayer!
[*] [b]Challenge anyone online[/b], racing them async with the Nemesis Mode
[*] [b]Create, share and play[/b] unique challenges from the community
[/list]

notes.title: Here’s how we build the perfect levels in Warstride Challenges
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

Ludwig Dresh here, Co-creator at Dream Powered Games, the small studio behind the ultra-fast first-person shooter Warstride Challenges. Our game has been in Early Access for the past ten months and it has been great to share the challenges of making this speed racing dream come true with an amazing community of Striders by our side. We are now super thrilled to bring the v1.0 of the game now on Steam.
We released a Launch Trailer which should give you a nice insight into the satisfying flow Warstride Challenges is all about: blasting hordes of demons at lightning speed, through increasingly intense time trials. Here's a bit about how we design a level in [i]Warstride Challenges[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/f67b1f6c329de60632917f9cb3afb2a08e39ced6.png[/img]

[h3]Our level design principles[/h3]

For each level, we first define a general theme, according to the weapons and the type of actions that will have to be performed to complete the level. These actions can involve shooting explosive urns, using slow-motion, engaging in melee combat, using the Stomp or the Grappling Hook. We also define the types of mechanism that come into play, such as shootable buttons and levers, as well as the traps. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/f47ada75c20dcc6403cb7a2499a36312373ba5f3.png[/img]

We have a lot of levels and we need to make sure they all feel different. To make sure of that, we use a sheet that compiles all of these defining features for each level. It’s an efficient tool that allows us to check if each new level is different enough from the previous one to keep things interesting. It’s also very convenient to quickly see the player progression and which new weapons and powers are introduced in each level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/86744f900730f33371d1c7951fbecc3e365d2dda.png[/img]

[i]Warstride Challenges[/i]’ level design approach is all about rushing forward and feeling like an unstoppable killing machine. The most important thing to keep in mind when designing a level is that it should be possible to go through it from A to Z without stopping. Aside from this consideration, the general flow of the level requires constant playtesting as we design, going back and forth to get a feel of what we are creating. 
That is really what will make all the difference. We first place the actions we want to start the level with (mostly enemies!), we then test it and ask ourselves: what is the boldest move we would like to perform next? Switching weapons to shred a guy into pieces with the shotgun? Taking a slider to boost our speed? Having a large drop and do a Stomp? And so on. This is, in my opinion, the best way to create levels that are sure to feel bombastic and utterly satisfying when we finally get to play them from start to end!

[b][i]Warstride Challenges[/i] is now available on Steam along with a free demo. We look forward to seeing you playing the awesome levels we designed and shared with the already vibrant community![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608470/Warstride_Challenges/?l=french

notes.title: Warstride Challenges v1.0 is live! Start your hellish trials now!
notes.content:
After a year of continuous improvements driven by community’s feedback, we’re delighted to finally release the v1.0 of [i]Warstride Challenges[/i] on Steam! Our small team is more than thankful for your support! Now, get ready to blast demons in satisfying fast-paced one-minute massacres! 

Want to give it a try and test your skills? [b]A free demo is available for both newcomers and challenge lovers on Steam[/b]. Discover this hectic fun with an explosive [b]Launch Trailer[/b] and spectacular screenshots!

[previewyoutube=70qK8wE41aI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Race against the clock[/h3]

In hellish challenges, [b]blast hordes of demons at lightning speed with powerful abilities and weapons[/b]. Slow time to pull off impossible headshots, bunny hop to pick up speed, slide around corners and shred your enemies into pieces with destructive shockwaves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/c39b6bb8c64d723fc3f53c9e9f1c954ff110c624.png[/img]

[h3]Become an FPS master[/h3]

[b]Easy to pick up, hard to master! Die and retry to chase the highest scores[/b], and show the world you’re the greatest demon slayer. Run to overcome every challenge that comes your way. Whether you’re an eSports pro or a shooter beginner, you’ll progress to become an FPS master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/7bf8364d703cb8ad025175effae9985c404d7d3c.png[/img]

[h3]Create, share and compete[/h3]

[b]Everyone can play a selection of levels created by the Steam community who designed the path, then choosed the enemies, obstacles and difficulty to create crazy trials in the Steam level editor on all platforms[/b]. Challenge yourself and other demon slayers, and race directly with the ghosts of anyone online in async mode - even your favorite streamers. Unleash your creativity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/1d347d5da08f0196250eeb985e667bec4be55317.png[/img]

[b]Warstride Challenges is out now, with hordes of demons to blast frantically on PC with a free demo on Steam. Don’t miss the 25% launch discount![/b]

notes.title: Warstride Challenges leaves Early Access September 7!
notes.content:
After more than a year in Early Access, [i][b]Warstride Challenges[/b][/i] is finally ready to launch its 1.0 version September 7! Eliminate all the demons in your path at lightning speed and get ready for all the challenges ahead with our new [b]Gameplay Overview Trailer[/b]!

[previewyoutube=Z4QB-NCY7IQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Balanced for the best experience for all players[/h3]

After almost [b]one year of Early Access to listen to the community feedback, we added loads of content[/b]. More than [b]60 intense trials[/b] have been added to the game, which ranges [b]from beginners content to the Very Hard difficulty[/b] mode for the most hardcore players of our community. We also debuted [b]fresh abilities and a new weapon[/b] to offer alternative ways to play. Burst your way through demons with [b]the stomp[/b], give foes your best headshot to foes with the carabin, and fling yourself around the stages as you unlock new maneuvers with [b]the grappling hook[/b].

To increase the competition between players, [b]we added the live multiplayer mode to race against your friends[/b] and finally find out which of you is the FPS master. Since we started early access, we have dedicated a lot of time and love to our community of builders on PC in order to [b]bring them the tools they needed to create the best levels for fellow players[/b]. On top of all that, with the 1.0 we will bring you even more content with tons of unfamiliar levels, and brand new gamemode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/d29fadb4082c9086cbe99aaf9e06200a83053cdb.gif[/img]

[b]Easy to learn but hard to master[/b], Warstride Challenges is made for anyone who wants to race and shoot demons at lightning speed whether they have never touched a computer or are seasoned tactical shooting veterans. [b]With an average of 92% of positive reviews[/b] from our players on Steam, we believe that speedrunners and shooter fans can find the challenging die & retry loop they deserve. [b]Compete with your friends and the community to get the highest score and race the ghosts of anyone online – even your favorite streamers![/b]

[b][i]Warstride Challenges[/i] 1.0 officially launches on September 7 with boat loads of new content on Steam. Experience high-speed shooting right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608470/Warstride_Challenges/?l=french]now with Early Access[/url]. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608470/Warstride_Challenges/

notes.title: Multiplayer Update + Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

Warstride Challenges just released a new major update full of content, adding the[b] Live Multiplayer mode[/b] and additional options and [b]content to the Level Editor.[/b] Time to challenge your friends in epic real-time races!
Discover it all in the new trailer now!

[previewyoutube=U4XA_dhCx_M;full][/previewyoutube]

This new update brings the[b] new Live Multiplayer mode[/b] for real-time speedruns, giving the Warstride community yet another opportunity to challenge each other as players[b] compete simultaneously through cups, a playlist of levels.[/b] New perspectives for a custom Warstride experience don’t stop here, and players can now access the [b]exciting new array of options brought to the Level Editor.[/b] An ever-improving feature of the game thanks to the community’s active feedback and sharings, the Level Editor keeps extending its functionalities, with a map curation and decorative objects.

notes.title: New levels and new gears in Update 4, now available! + Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We’re adding plenty of new content with today’s update, bringing a new chapter with its batch of original levels and two new gears: the Grappling Hook and the Rocket Launcher! Check out the fresh new content from this update in the trailer!

[previewyoutube=eytw-s12n9s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New challenges await you[/h2]

This new update starts unveiling Chapter 3, which the community has been awaiting, bringing 24 new and more open levels, as well as new bonus levels. You’ll find several challenges in two different difficulty modes—normal and hard—and bonus levels to unlock thanks to feats and discoveries.

Fire your weapon through The Forge, a hellish new environment. Spill demon blood all over its wide rooms, and face ever more ferocious enemies, ever difficult goals! Be even faster than before, choose the right weapons and reach the finish line within the time limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/0cb838ed26e7c9f4c1ac56a9075d0af3e3e92144.gif[/img]

Use your hook on platforms to increase your speed and taste the power of an all-new weapon to blast all enemies standing on your way. Finally, thanks to the implementation of an aim-assist, you may now kill your opponents in style using an impressive 360 noscope of the highest standard!

notes.title: Update 3 and Reaction Trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Striders![/h2]

We’re delighted to see everyone’s reaction to Warstride Challenges! We made a little compilation of your best moments, we hope you’ll like it! Discover joy, excitement and maybe a bit of rage from our players in today’s Reaction Trailer, as well as the warm reception from press! 

[previewyoutube=FFFUAB-hEn0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Warstride journey continues[/h2]

Following its recent Early Access launch on Steam, Warstride has already dropped a series of updates, introducing 24 new challenges by adding the Very Hard levels to Chapters 1 and 2, a deadly new power—Stomp, a more accessible Level Editor, and improved UI and functionality with a new main menu and bug fixes.

Even more lands today with 4 new ‘Big Fun Levels’ added to Chapters 1 and 2 in Very Hard, as well as new content for the level editor such as the Carabine! The community has a lot to still look forward to in Warstride Challenges! Read down below for the complete patch notes!

notes.title: Warstride Challenges ramps up the challenge with its first update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

[b]2 weeks after its Early Access launch, Warstride Challenges releases its first update today,[/b] available for all players on [b]Steam![/b]
[b]The first of many,[/b] this update sees [b]the arrival of Very Hard mode for Chapter 1, and improvements for the Level Editor.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/b70ab66198b63c253ebfba01dae4b0f6eca9499d.png[/img]

[h2]The Warstride journey begins with the first of many updates[/h2]

This first update gives you a first taste of the [b]Very Hard difficulty level, unlocking it for Chapter 1 with 12 additional levels.[/b] Do you have what it takes to beat the clock? Furthermore, [b]many improvements and fixes[/b] have been made, with a focus on [b]making the Level Editor more accessible and precise[/b] with quality of life improvements and additional blocks. [b]More details in the patch notes below. [/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1608470]A Level Editor Guide[/url] has also been created to give you tips about map creation.[/b] Creating your own devious and sadistic trials is now easier than ever - [b]let your imagination run wild and don’t hesitate to share your creations with the community![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/c3aa7dd12494e566ee4bf83fbc2316ae79b13abb.gif[/img]

[h2]Warstride Challenges You![/h2]

The community contest is now over. Our winners will get some awesome prizes thanks to our partner Intel, but that’s not all! To reward all of our participants and amazing community, we’re offering a promo code for redemption on the Focus Store. Stay tuned for more exciting contests in the coming weeks! #WarstrideChallenges

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608470/Warstride_Challenges/

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[h3]GAME[/h3]

[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] 12 very hard level from Chapter 1: Crypt
[*] Added bindings for StatMenu, ToggleGhost,ToggleHud
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Tuto quick restart, platform are now more obvious
[*] Tuto quick restart, fixed trigger for restart tip
[*] Hole and floating stone in Crypt 3 Hard
[*] Collisions issues in Crypt 9 Side room
[*] Crypt 9 Hard is now Very Hard, and Very Hard is Hard (score have been reset)
[*] BFL Crypt 2: Hard leaderboard reset due to change of Crypt 9
[*] Button inside walls in low settings in Ruins 15
[*] Reload tips won’t be displayed if no ammo 
[*] Removed Ammo in Bonus 9
[*] Bigger hitbox for small enemies
[*] Important light optimisation on center room of Chapter 2 Special level
[*] Fixed DLSS setting not being saved
[*] Fixed crash when quick restarting on a bumper
[*] Fixed no toggle slow motion being inverted after a quick restart 
[*] Caped kill sound to 10 in buffer 
[/list]

[b]Accessibility[/b]

[list]
[*] Added option to disable Crosshair Color change hover enemies, causing visibility issues to Daltonians.
[/list]

[h3]LEVEL EDITOR[/h3]

[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] New Autosaves System
[*] New Confirmation box UI
[*] Show downloaded levels in "Downloads Levels" window
[*] Removed grid and camera max height
[*] Grid and Camera with higher location (allow to build below starting position)
[*] Save grid’s height and scale during the session and restore it after testing a level
[*] Now show creator name in the thumbnail of the level
[*] Removed camera inertia
[*] Removed "New Level" button from "Save Load" window
[*] New basic blocks : 2xWall with round hole, ceiling, cylinder, spike & H?!
[*] New prefab : Small Room with 4 Doors
[*] Display map creator’s name
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Community Level Browser: fix description overflowing
[*] Show level name in Tab and End window
[*] Avoid Autosaves to be the last active save
[*] Allow to place elements without the grid active
[*] Bind Num pad “+” and  “-” to change the grid scale (was bound to camera speed before)
[*] Reload tips won’t be displayed if no ammo 
[*] Going back to brush mode will select last selected brush
[*] Added min/max for world settings

notes.title: Level Editor guide
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

You'll find below a guide to understand how to properly use the Level Editor tool of the game. 
Happy reading!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Display Help panel: [b]H[/b]
[*] Level Editor “Pause” Menu : [b]Esc[/b], press again to resume
[*] Undo: Ctrl+Z
[*] Redo: Ctrl+Y
[/list][i]Known issues: [/i]
- Controls in the Level Editor cannot be changed
- Shortcuts displayed in the UI and the Help panel are set for QWERTY keyboard by default

[b]Camera:[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera movement: [b]W, A, S, D[/b]
[*] Camera forward/backward : [b]Alt + Right-click[/b]
[*] Camera height:[b] mouse wheel[/b] or hold [b]Right-click + Left-click[/b]
[*] Camera rotation: hold [b]Right-click[/b] or hold [b]Alt + Left-click[/b]
[*] Camera movement speed: Click on [b]camera pink button[/b], or use [b]C[/b], or hold [b]Shift[/b] while moving camera
[*] Focus on selected object: [b]F[/b]
[/list][i]Known issues: [/i]
- Moving the camera while selecting an item in the UI may block the camera movement in one direction. Opening the Pause Menu at this moment will block the camera movement entirely. Save your level, go back to the main menu and reload your level in the Level Editor to unblock the camera.
- Holding Shift to move the camera faster may not work after several Alt+Tab. Go back to the Main Menu and reload your level to fix it.

[b]Grid:[/b]
[list]
[*] While the grid is on, objects will clip on the grid lines and elevation. Disable the grid for a free positioning of items.
[*] Toggle the grid : Click on [b]On/Off grid pink button[/b] or use [b]G[/b]. 
[*] Change the grid size : Click on the [b]250 grid pink button[/b] or use [b]+ and -[/b]
[*] Change the grid height : [b]Ctrl + mouse wheel[/b]. Trying to move the camera under the grid will also lower the grid
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/c42eb645990f709379693c0d7b710a7421e93868.gif[/img]

[i]Known issues: [/i]
- You can’t select or place an item through the grid. The camera must be on the same side of the grid to properly select and position items on the grid, or the grid must be disabled.

[b]Creating, saving and loading a level:[/b]
[list]
[*] Click on the [b]Save button[/b] or hit [b]Ctrl+S[/b]:
[list]
[*] Save you current level
[*] Load a previous save of your level or load a different level
[/list]
[*] Your creations are automatically saved on a regular basis and everytime you play your level.
[*] You can create a new level, or save and load, from the [b]Esc.[/b] menu.
[/list]
[b]Editing mode VS Brush mode:[/b]
[list]
[*] Your cursor can either be in creation mode aka “Brush” or editing mode.
[*] It will be in Brush mode by default with the first objects from the items list ready to be placed (a 10x10 wall) when starting a new level. 
[*] You can change the cursor mode by clicking the [b]Move/Brush button[/b] on top of the screen or hitting [b]Q[/b].
[*] Clicking an item in the UI will automatically switch to creation mode.
[/list]
[b]Adding objects (Brush mode):[/b]
[list]
[*] You can add objects by selecting a tab in the objects menu, then an object. 
[list]
[list]
[*] Blockout elements: 
[*] Rooms :  full elements including floor, walls and ceiling
[*] Blocks : simple objects of various sizes to design your very own rooms and obstacles
[/list]
[*] Static Meshes
[list]
[*] Rooms and Corridors : full elements including floor, walls and ceiling, [b]using Main game textures (Crypt, Ruins and Forge)[/b]
[*] Single Meshes : simple objects of various sizes to design your very own rooms and obstacles, [b]using Main game textures (Crypt, Ruins and Forge)[/b]
[*] Decorative Objects : Simple decorative objects from Main game levels
[/list]
[*] Special elements
[list]
[*] Gameplay: Interactive placeables : Urns, Weapons, bumpers… For interactive elements logic system, see Adding interactive elements
[*] Enemies : Placeable enemies
[*] Traps : Traps and death zones
[*] Various:  starting and end level points, trigger boxes and helpers
[/list]
[*] Lighting devices: Placeable point lights
[/list]
[*] The object blueprint will be displayed in green under your cursor.
[*] Use R to rotate the blueprint 90° on the z axis
[*] Click to place the object.
[*] Remember to disable the grip if you want a more precise control on your Brush tool.
[/list]
[i]Known issue: [/i]
- Geometry objects can overlap and will display visual clipping on overlapping areas. If too many objects overlap, they will appear elsewhere.

[b]Editing objects (Edit mode):[/b]
[list]
[*] You can edit objects by clicking on the[b] Brush/Edit button[/b] or using [b]Q[/b].
[*]  A 3-axis icon will be displayed over the last selected object. To edit another object, click on it.
[*] Hit [b]E[/b] to move, [b]R[/b] to rotate it and [b]T[/b] to resize the object on the 3 axis.
[list]
[*] Resize only works on geometry objects. You can try and resize enemies but they will spawn in your level at their default size. 
[/list]
[*] You can also toggle between move, rotate and stretch view using [b]Space[/b].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/4941a2548b2b02f2797b9f7fc80826ecb48d9cd8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/ce5a290c2b1fee6614724e77638b86a7d04e61f5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/0ad10bfb205810f2dcbacddd9fc3c7313f8c74c6.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Click and drag an axis to move, rotate or stretch the object on this axis.
[*] To select a group of objects, hold [b]Ctrl and click[/b] to add or remove objects from a group. Selected items will be outlined in yellow.
[*] To duplicate an object or a group of objects, [b]hold Shift and click and drag[/b] a move axis.
[*] To delete an object or a group of objects, select it and hit [b]Del.[/b]
[*] Hit [b]Esc.[/b] to unselect the selected object or group of objects.
[*] Remember to disable the grip if you want a more precise control on your editing tool.
[/list]

[b]Adding starting and end level points:[/b]
[list]
[*] Every level needs a start and an end in order to be completed.
[*] To add a starting point, select the Special elements tab in the Object menu or use F4, then select the Start button.
[*] Use R to rotate the blueprint 90° on the z axis, which will change the direction the player is facing when starting the level, and click to place your starting point.
[*] You can only place one starting point. Trying to place a second one will just remove the first one.
[*] To add an end level point, select the Special elements tab in the Object menu or use F4, then click the End level button. Click to place your exit point.
[*] The End level area is a cube with an highlighted face. The highlighted face is the one the player will have to go through in order to complete the level. Make sure to make it face in the right direction.
[*] Just like other objects, you can resize, move around and rotate the End Level area. 
[/list]

[b]Adding special elements (logic system):[/b]
Enemies and interactives elements such as bumpers or levers obey to a logic system
Adding such elements to the level will display the logic system panel on the right side of the screen and the following options, depending on the element:
[list]
[*] Activation delay : used on elements activated in game by the player. “Is On” must be unchecked. Adding a delay will add time between the moment the player activates the element and the moment activation occurs
[*] Is On : if checked, the element will be activated when the game starts. A bumper will be active, a door will be opened, a lever will be pulled, and so on. If unchecked, the element will need to be activated by the player thanks to another element
[*] Is Enablable : if checked, the element can be activated by the player. If unchecked it cannot be activated by the player until another condition is fulfilled
[*] Outputs : clicking on the “+” button lets you select which elements are activated when the player activates this element. For example, adding enemy spawners to a trigger box outputs will make these enemies appear when the player enters the trigger zone. Adding a hook block to a first block outputs will make the second block active when the first block is used by the player. You can delete an outputs element by clicking on its “-” icon.
[*] Is Optional Spawner (enemies only) : if checked, the enemy spawner won’t need to be triggered or the enemy to be killed in order to finish the level. This is useful for creating alternate paths. If unchecked, activating the End level zone will require the spawner to be triggered and the enemy to be killed, so make sure you don’t place an enemy spawner in an unreachable area and that the activating elements (trigger box, lever…) can’t be missed by the player..
[*] Turret mode (enemies only) :Turret mode (enemies only) : if unchecked, enemies will move to attack the player. If checked, they won't move and will only attack when in range.
[/list]
[i]Known issue: [/i]
- When clicking on the Outputs “+” icon while being in brush mode, first switch to edit mode (shortcut Q) before clicking on the element you want to add


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/96e60aff80fa40d7458a3ec5a924dbb7c581c993.gif[/img]

[b]Editing the world settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Click on the gamepad icon on the right side of the screen to display the game rules. There you can edit the time limit for each medal. Make sure you set achievable goals for your level to be completed by others. A good way to verify this is to try and get the medals from your own level before publishing it. 
[*] Click on the handgun icon on the right side of the screen to display the loadout. There you can edit the number of bullets and clips for each weapon as well as available powers.
[/list]

[b]Object settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Select an object that as settings to edit : Enemies, Lights, Interactive elements
[*] Click on the Cursor button to open the Object Settings
[*] You can change various settings, depending on the object you want to modify. Enemies can be set in Turret mode and won’t move, you can change the color or the intensity of the lights, you can select the number of ammos of pick up weapons…
[/list]

[b]Lighting Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Click on the light Bulb
[*] You can select any lighting biome you like, small loadings might occur.
[/list]

[b]Testing a level:[/b]
[list]
[*] Click on the character+play blue uttonor use Alt+P to try your level from the start
[*] Click on the eye+play blue button or use Ctrl+P to play from the closest point the camera is facing. This can be handy when testing a specific section of a long level.
[*] Using the [b]character+play icon[/b] or [b]Alt+P[/b] will make you start from the camera view if no starting point has been placed.
[*] In testing mode, you can restart your level as many times as you want using Tab, just like you would in a real game level.
[*] To exit test mode, use [b]Esc [/b]
[/list]

[b]Publishing a level:[/b]
[list]
[*] Before publishing your level, make sure that:
[list]
[*] It has a start and end zone
[*] All non optional enemies are triggered by the player’s path and can be killed with sufficient ammo and powers
[*] End zone is properly triggered and the level is finishable.
[*] All medal times are achievable, bronze time being at least 2 seconds
[*] You have tested and completed your level yourself.
[*] You have saved your level.
[/list]
[*] When you are ready to publish your level, click on the blue upload button or use Ctrl+E.
[*] Give a name to your level and fill the description field to make other players want to play your level.
[*] Your level will now be playable by other players by selecting Community levels in the game main menu
[/list]

[b]Playing other people’s level[/b]
[list]
[*] You can access the list of other players’ levels by clicking the Community levels button in the Main Menu
[*] Click on a level title to display its description. Additional info will be added in later updates. Download number, type, difficulty, rating and screenshot are placeholders.
[*] Click on Download to add the level to add it to your playable levels
[*] Go to the Play levels tab, click on the level you downloaded and click Play to test it
[*] Click on the red button to delete a community level from your list 
[*] While playing, hit Esc to go back to community level selection
[/list]

notes.title: New Closed Beta Update !
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

We have pushed a new version with a few small (and bigs) changes for the closed beta !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/1f759f3281151a577c6acb80fcb7b086b30e876d.png[/img]

[b]Changelist[/b] :

[b]Important features :[/b]
-Manoeuvrability at high speed improved (try Demo 5 Corner!)
-Momentum improved: keep more momentum when doing a bunny hop after a slide hop
-Slide hop speed increase
-Speed O Meter : uses an averaged speed value over the last 0.1sec and not instant speed for better visual results. So the speed value shown cannot be compared to the values you were getting with Micrologist’s implementation. Actual top speed can be slightly higher than the one displayed
-When you beat the gold medal on a tutorial, you will then see your own ghost and not the tutorial ghost
-Several kill sounds are played when you kill many enemies at once (with a melee for example)
-Bumper and slider in test map added  (added on test map)

We need your feedback on these, let us know if previous records are within reach, or if you want us to tweak the movements mechanics further.
We will then reset the highscores once you guys are happy with the improved character controller mechanics.

[b]Improvements :[/b]

- Collisions updated on various tutorials
- Medal time reduced for some of the tutorials
- UI to load test maps
- Bumper and slider in test map added 
- Options menu rework (better categories & improved readability)
- Options menu tooltips on mouse hover
- Slide jump consistency 
- Nvidia DLSS: better performance at no visual cost!
- No more level selection button in pause menu until you have finished intro tutorials 
- Calibration starts on first game launch and not when you click on “play the demo” 
- No more restart tips after getting the gold medal

[b]Bug Fixes :[/b]

- switched two level’s thumbnails (6 & 7)

PS: You can still get keys by joining our Discord/Twitter !
[url=https://discord.com/invite/vYv4QhgE7y][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/38a3e523fa40bbd7195cded5d69b34615d8f6360.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/warcrythegame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/d3d24be4cdf401892601056be2de7196d1545db5.png[/img][/url]
